knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The compressor and its pipes form the sealed refrigerant circuit, which is outside the cleaning scope.
Regulation 111 makes it an offence to carry out work on RAC equipment without a licence, so a refrigerant handling licence is the answer.
The inlet is internal water work and is excluded. The worker dries, records and refers. Changing the filter is not part of the course.
The drain is checked from outside only. Tools inserted into an internal drain line are excluded.
Refrigerant can cause frostbite on contact, and some refrigerants are flammable, so a leak is a hazard in its own right.

practicalCriteria: Records the refrigeration and water boundary before cleaning, with excluded parts marked
Cleans the drip tray, bin, cabinet exterior, bin lid and door seal only
Checks the drain outlet from outside without inserting tools
Stops and records a leak or fault without changing any internal part
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate: an assessor observes the practical criteria and records the result. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not grant any licence or authority.
evidenceRequired: Refrigeration and water boundary record with photographs
Waste disposal record for bin and drip tray contents
Referral record for any leak, blockage or abnormal noise
stopWorkCriteria: Cleaning or brushing the condenser coil before the boundary is confirmed
Changing an inlet filter or opening the cabinet
Any tool inserted into the internal drain line
